name: 62618 · Beardstown, IL
findings: ZIP 62618 (Beardstown) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62618 (Beardstown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 62618 (Beardstown) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
